# Week 5: Raster Review: Climate Analysis in California
## Practice raster manipulations

| Property          | PRISM 4km (tmean)                   | PRISM 4km (ppt)                     | PRISM 800 m (ppt)                   |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
| Spatial Resolution| 0.04167 deg                         | 0.04167 deg                         | 0.00833 deg                         |
| Temporal Coverage | 1991-2020                           | 1991-2020                           |  1991-2020                          |
| CRS               | North American Datum of 1983; GRS80 | North American Datum of 1983; GRS80 | North American Datum of 1983; GRS80 |
| Units             | Degrees C                           | Millimeters                         | Millimeters                         |



### Setup
```{r}
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(kableExtra)
```

### Load and Inspect Data
`rast()` reads GeoTIFF files directly. Each file contains a single layer.
```{r}
annual_temp  <- rast("data/data_week5/prism_tmean_us_25m_2020_avg_30y/prism_tmean_us_25m_2020_avg_30y.tif")

annual_prec  <- rast("data/data_week5/prism_ppt_us_25m_2020_avg_30y/prism_ppt_us_25m_2020_avg_30y.tif")

prec_800m    <- rast("data/data_week5/prism_ppt_us_30s_2020_avg_30y/prism_ppt_us_30s_2020_avg_30y.tif")
```
